objectives: Identify common factors of whole numbers
Find the HCF of whole numbers
Identify the difference between LCM and HCF
Solve problems on quantitative aptitude involving LCM and HCF of whole numbers

subtopics.title: LCM and HCF of given whole numbers

teacher_activities: Leads students to: (i) identify common factors using common factor and prime factor methods, (ii) find the HCF of some whole numbers e.g. HCF of 15 and 80, (iii) identify the difference between LCM and HCF
Guides students in prime factorization: 28 = 2 × 14 = 2 × 2 × 7, so prime factors of 28 are 2 and 7
Leads students to solve quantitative aptitude problems e.g. find the missing number: 28 → 2².7; 84 → ?
student_activities: Write common factors and highest common factors of a given set of numbers
Express whole numbers as prime factors
Solve problems to find the HCF of whole numbers
Identify the difference between LCM and HCF
Solve related problems on quantitative aptitude
tlm: HCF Chart containing worked examples; HCF/LCM Charts
eval_guide: Find the HCF of given whole numbers
